hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r p; case "$p" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/frontend/src/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/frontend/src/*.html|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/frontend/src/*.scss) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$p";; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
